snippet.title: EverSiege: Untold Ages | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
EverSiege: Untold Ages is a co-op top down action-strategy roguelite where every choice counts. Wishlist now 👉 https://bitly.dearvillagers.com/eversiege

Bastion holds the last beacon of hope in a broken world. Scyron, once banished by the ancient gods, you're summoned to break the EverSiege.

⚔️ Rebuild the kingdom, use Divine Wargears, and combine them with Essences like fire, ice, lightning, etc. 
⚔️ Adapt your tactics in real time to overcome the hordes of the Unraveller and reclaim what was lost long ago. 
⚔️ Backtrack through time to defeat all versions of the Evil Master.
 
Wishlist us on Steam & hop into our Discord for exclusive playtests: https://discord.gg/eversiege
